title: NMRFinesse: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: NMRFinesse automates Bruker multidimensional NMR processing with NMRPipe and SMILE, records processing parameters and quality-control decisions, and provides spectrum viewing and peak localization. Version 1.0.9 / API 1.1.5 introduces the NMRFinesse name and selects dominant peak polarity using squared signal-to-noise weights, preventing numerous weak opposite-sign candidates from overruling stronger signals. Explicit sign requests and mixed-sign experiments are preserved. Reference optimization component scores and the 38-column peak table remain available.
